observations: Two photos show the same dining set from different angles in what appears to be a residential dining room.
Table has a glossy marble-patterned top (could be real marble, engineered stone, or a marble-effect laminate) on dark wooden/metal legs.
Chairs are upholstered in beige/cream velvet-look fabric with tufted (button) backs and dark wooden legs.
In photo 0, 5 chairs are visible (2 left, 2 right, 1 front).
In photo 1, 5 chairs are visible (2 left, 2 right, 1 partial at back).
Visible blotchy, whitish stain marks on the fabric of several chair backs and seats in both photos (most noticeable on the chair backs facing camera).
Watermark text 'POSTED ON JIJI OMOTOSHO JIMOH' overlays both images, consistent with a reposted listing photo, not independently verifiable as the seller's own stock.
Room shows sheer curtains, tiled floor, and a tripod/ring light partially visible in photo 0 background, suggesting an indoor home or showroom setting.

identity.kind: 6-seater dining table and chair set (faux/real marble-top table with tufted velvet chairs)

claims.evidence: Only 5 chairs are countable in either photo; no single shot shows all 6 together to confirm the full count.
Photo 0 and photo 1 both show visible blotchy stain marks on the fabric of multiple chairs, indicating wear or soiling.
Location and availability cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: Missing 6th chair may not exist or may not match the others
risks.proof: A single photo with all 6 chairs and the table together, unobstructed

risks.risk: Stains on fabric could be deeper damage, odor, or permanent discoloration
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each stained chair in good lighting
risks.if_unproven: priced as having noticeable cosmetic defect / reduced condition

risks.risk: Table top material unclear (real marble vs. laminate/engineered stone) which affects value significantly
risks.proof: Close-up photo of table edge/underside showing material thickness and texture
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value laminate/engineered option

risks.risk: Structural soundness of chair legs and table joints not shown
risks.proof: Photo or short video of the set being touched/shifted, or underside of table and chair legs
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified structural condition, i.e. worst case

risks.risk: Photos may be stock/reposted images (watermark from another lister 'Omotosho Jimoh') rather than the actual item in seller's possession
risks.proof: A fresh photo with a handwritten date/name note, or a live video call showing the set in situ
risks.if_unproven: priced with added discount for provenance uncertainty

proof_requests: One clear photo showing all 6 chairs and the table together in the same frame.
Close-up photos of the stained areas on the chair fabric.
Close-up of the table edge or underside to confirm material (marble vs laminate).
A short video or extra photo confirming the set is currently in the seller's possession (to rule out reposted stock images).
response.reason: The item type and worst-case condition are identifiable from the photos (a faux/possible real marble dining set with tufted chairs showing visible staining and only 5 confirmed chairs), so it can be priced conservatively at worst case while flagging the unverified chair count, condition claim, and image provenance for further proof.
